summary: The root S-R-R primarily signifies concealment and secrecy, like hiding something within oneself or in a designated place.

headwords.def: سُرْسُورٌ Intelligent; knowing; skilful; (S, M, K;) entering much into affairs, (S, K,) by means of his good artifices or artful contrivances. (TA.) You say, هُوَ سُرْسُورُ مَالٍ He is one who manages well, or takes good care of, property, or cattle, (AA, M, * K, * TA,) knowing what is conducive to the good thereof. (AA, TA.) And هُوَ ٱبْنُ سُرْسُورِهَا He is the knowing with respect to it. (T in art. بنى .) A person beloved, or a friend; a special, or choice, companion; (K;) as also . (TA.) Also The نَصْل [or spun thread, that has come forth, ] of the spindle. (K.)

headwords.def: أَسَرُّ An adventive; one abiding among a people to whom he is not related; syn. دَخِيلٌ . (S, K.) Lebeed says, وَجَدِّى فَارِسُ الرَّعْشَآءِ مِنْهُمْ رَئِيسٌ لَا أَسَرُّ وَلَا سَنِيدُ [ And my grandfather, the rider of Er-Raashà, was of them; a chief, not an adventive, nor of suspected origin ]. (S.) Also a camel having a gall, or sore, in the كِرْكِرَة [or callous projection upon the breast ]: (S:) or having a pain therein, arising from a gall, or sore: (K:) or having sores in the hinder part thereof, nearly penetrating into his inside, but not mortal: or having the disorder termed ضَبٌّ , which is a tumour in the breast: (M:) fem. سَرَّآءُ .
